name: rosetta-dot-product
code:
use default

dot(left: int[], right: int[]) -> int is
    assert left.count == right.count else "vectors must be the same length"

    return left
        |> zip(right, (a, b) => a * b)
        |> reduce(0, (running, product) => running + product)
si

write_line("{dot([1, 3, -5], [4, -2, -1])}")
